default.$description: Default page and application background; the base layer every view starts from.

raised.$description: Background for content lifted above the page — cards, menus, popovers, dialogs. Pair with shadow.raised or shadow.overlay.

sunken.$description: Recessed background for wells, inset panels, code blocks, and zebra stripes that sit visually below the default surface.

sunken-hover.$description: Hover/pressed step for interactive sunken surfaces, e.g. the Switch off-state track under the pointer. One ramp step darker than color.surface.sunken; not a text background.

overlay.$description: Base color for modal backdrops and scrims. Components apply their own opacity on top of this color; it is not a text background.

inverse.$description: High-contrast dark surface for inverted regions such as tooltips and dark banners. Pair text with color.text.inverse.

primary.$description: Primary reading color for body copy and headings on default, raised, and sunken surfaces.

secondary.$description: Supporting text — descriptions, captions, secondary labels. Lower emphasis than primary while staying AA on all light surfaces.

muted.$description: De-emphasized text for placeholders, hints, and metadata. The lightest text color that remains AA on all light surfaces.

inverse.$description: Text used on color.surface.inverse and other dark regions such as tooltips.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink color; AA-checked on default, raised, and sunken surfaces.

on-accent.$description: Text and icon color for accent-filled controls; AA-checked against color.accent.default and color.accent.emphasis.

default.$description: Primary brand action color for filled controls, selection indicators, and key highlights; AA-checked against color.text.on-accent.

emphasis.$description: Stronger accent for hover and active states of accent-filled controls; AA-checked against color.text.on-accent.

muted.$description: Soft accent tint for selected-item backgrounds and subtle highlights. Never a text color.

default.$description: Standard border for inputs, cards, and separators on light surfaces.

muted.$description: Hairline border for subtle separation — table rows, quiet card outlines.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast border for hovered inputs and emphasized boundaries.

focus.$description: Focus-indicator border and outline color; used together with shadow.focus-ring.

default.$description: Informational status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

emphasis.$description: Stronger informational hue for hover/active states of solid info fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

surface.$description: Tinted background for informational alerts and badges.

border.$description: Border for informational alerts and badges.

text.$description: Text on color.status.info.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

default.$description: Success status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

emphasis.$description: Stronger success hue for hover/active states of solid success fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

surface.$description: Tinted background for success alerts and badges.

border.$description: Border for success alerts and badges.

text.$description: Text on color.status.success.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

default.$description: Warning status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

emphasis.$description: Stronger warning hue for hover/active states of solid warning fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

surface.$description: Tinted background for warning alerts and badges.

border.$description: Border for warning alerts and badges.

text.$description: Text on color.status.warning.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

default.$description: Danger/destructive status hue for icons, solid fills, and destructive controls; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

emphasis.$description: Stronger danger hue for hover/active states of solid danger fills (e.g. danger Button hover); AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

surface.$description: Tinted background for danger alerts and badges.

border.$description: Border for danger alerts, badges, and invalid form fields.

text.$description: Text on color.status.danger.surface and for inline error messages; the pair is AA-checked at build time.
